introduction: 15年前，我的三位朋友前往荒山野岭进行露营冒险。自此，他们将这样的露营冒险戏称为“荒野求生”。这和贝爷的真人秀节目同名。他们所留下的视频照片成为了我这些年来一直回味的东西。它们也紧密连接着我的记忆和创作，更让我试图以不同的方式接近和体验“荒野求生”。15 years ago, three of my friends went to the wild mountains for a camping adventure. Since then, they have jokingly called this camping adventure "Man vs. Wild". It has the same name as Bear Grylls' reality show. The videos and photos they left behind have become something I have been reminiscing about over the years. They are also closely connected to my memories and creation, and have made me try to approach and experience "Man vs. Wild" in different ways.
